title: The World's Most Dangerous Bird Mostly Eats Fruit
subject: southern cassowary

scenes.text: The world's most dangerous bird mostly eats fruit.
It's the southern cassowary. It stands up to two meters tall, and big females weigh up to 76 kilograms.
Its weapon is on its feet: a dagger-like claw up to 12 centimeters long.
It can run up to 50 kilometers an hour and jump nearly two meters straight up.
Yet only two human deaths have been reported since 1900, one in 1926 and one in 2019.
Armed like that, it still spends most of its time eating fallen fruit off the forest floor.
